summary: A 1930 tower on Huckleberry Mountain in Wallowa County was staffed into the 1940s and was gone by the 1950s; no current description of the site was found.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone. The register says it was destroyed in the 1950s; firelookout.com says abandoned then.

events.note: Register gives 1930; an August 1930 item reports materials packed in for a lookout

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's 1930 date fits the August 1930 report that materials were being packed in; the report does not confirm completion.

notes_for_editor: The source places Mills on Huckleberry Butte; that is not confirmed as this summit. Thin evidence: no design, height or exact removal year. The 1950s decade is the only fate date; the record's removed year 1950 is an approximation and could be changed to a decade note. Register and Oregon list give different summit coordinates. WebSearch returned unrelated Huckleberry Mountains (Lewis County WA, Teton NF Wyoming, Prospect OR), excluded. Wallowa-Whitman NF archives or a Wallowa County historical society could confirm the dates.
